items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: that's how Joe Welsh, you remember him? Joe Welsh? Yeah.

ctx.x: Let me see. Pee-o-little, and uh, that's how Joe Welsh, you remember him? Joe Welsh? Yeah. Well, yeah. Johnny Delpy. Oh, he's all right. Willie Foster, he used to play violin, you know. You know him, man. Willie, you know his brother George, huh? Yeah. Ask him who played the barrel house music on the violin. Say, who played the barrel house music on the violin? With Johnny?
